description: Returns a trading profile for one member of Congress from CTA's records: trade count, buys and sells, first and last trade dates, average disclosure lag, party, chamber, state, and committee assignments. member_name must exactly match the stored member name (the STOCK Act filer name with honorifics removed, often a legal name); a name that does not match returns total_trades 0 and no error, so resolve names with search_members_and_tickers first. The profile covers only trades filed under that exact spelling.

member_name.description: Exact stored member name, e.g. "Tommy Tuberville"; look it up with search_members_and_tickers

name: get_member_profile
title: Member Profile
